description: RbNa₅(WN₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three N atoms. There are two shorter (2.93 Å) and one longer (3.17 Å) Rb-N bond length. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Rb-N bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.23 Å. There are ten inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.80 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WN₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.52 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.92 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.85 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WN₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.49 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.69 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.83 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.77 Å. In the ninth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.88 Å. In the tenth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.82 Å. There are four inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two WN₄ tetrahedra and corners with four NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.94 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.94 Å. In the third W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.96 Å. In the fourth W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form corner-sharing WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.94 Å. There are twelve inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Rb, four Na, and one W atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one W atom. In the third N site, N is bonded to four Na and two W atoms to form NNa₄W₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NNa₄W₂ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NRbNa₃W₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Rb, four Na, and one W atom. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Rb, three Na, and one W atom. In the sixth N site, N is bonded to one Rb, three Na, and two W atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NRbNa₃W₂ octahedra. In the seventh N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Rb, four Na, and one W atom. In the eighth N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one W atom. In the ninth N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one W atom. In the tenth N site, N is bonded to four Na and two W atoms to form distorted NNa₄W₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NNa₄W₂ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NRbNa₃W₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. In the eleventh N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Rb, three Na, and one W atom. In the twelfth N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Rb, three Na, and two W atoms.
